comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: One order for class members
themes.text: `nvs code order` and the editor's *Order class members* action put the members of every class in one order. `#[Core\Json\KeepKeyOrder]` keeps the JSON key order of a class that needs it.
